checks.name: service_token
checks.notes: ADR ZabAuth 003 Am.3 § A3.6 R21 / RC 51. State word only — no token material, no family_id, no expiry. Never changes the status code: `degraded` (no token: nothing resolvable at boot, or a refresh ZabAuth rejected terminally) and `unpersisted` (a rotation advanced server-side but its successor is not yet in Postgres; the manager retries the persist on its own bounded backoff) are operator signals, not liveness verdicts. The show stays on air in all three; only token-bearing outbound calls fail, and they fail closed.

notes: Orion v2 (Go) in production. Readiness returns 503 only on a database ping failure; the service_token field is informational.
